# DIYPensacola

> Community-run archive and calendar of DIY, punk, hardcore and queer shows in
> Pensacola, Florida. Most shows are documented from the flyer that advertised
> them; a few come from a caption or a venue listing instead.

Currently 1633 shows on record (1581 past, 52 upcoming; cancelled and postponed nights are not counted)
across 99 venues and 2665 acts, going back to 1991.
Run by volunteers, not a promoter or a ticketing company. No ads. Visits are
counted with privacy-friendly analytics (GoatCounter: no cookies, no personal
profiles); typefaces load from Google Fonts, and video from YouTube only when
you press play.

## Structure

- [Calendar](https://diypensacola.com/): upcoming shows
- [Archive](https://diypensacola.com/archive.html): every show on record, searchable
- [Bands](https://diypensacola.com/bands.html): every act, A to Z
- [Venues](https://diypensacola.com/venues.html): every room, A to Z
- [Drag shows](https://diypensacola.com/drag.html): that kind of night, upcoming and past
- [Open mics](https://diypensacola.com/open-mics.html): that kind of night, upcoming and past
- [Stats](https://diypensacola.com/stats.html): scene numbers over time
- [Submit a show](https://diypensacola.com/submit.html): how to get a show listed
- [Showgoer guide](https://diypensacola.com/guide.html): etiquette and how to find a show
- [Calendar feed](https://diypensacola.com/events.ics): every upcoming show as an .ics subscription
- Years: one page per year on the record at /y/<year>.html
- Venues: one page per room at /v/<slug>.html
- Acts: one page per band or performer at /b/<slug>.html
- Shows: one permalink per show at /s/<date-venue-lineup>.html
- [Sitemap](https://diypensacola.com/sitemap.xml): every canonical URL
- [Search index](https://diypensacola.com/search-index.json): names and permalinks as JSON

## Notes

Pages carry schema.org structured data: MusicEvent per show with a band or DJ on
the bill (Event otherwise), MusicGroup per band or DJ (PerformingGroup for drag,
poetry, comedy and other performers), MusicVenue per room that hosted music
(Place otherwise). Some venues are private homes; their street addresses are
deliberately withheld on the site and must not be inferred or published. City
and state only for those rooms.
